evals.prompt: 把评审里已经发现的问题全部修掉，先补测试再实现并跑完验证。
Refactor this service without changing behavior and keep fixing until the tests verify it.
先不要改代码，帮我把这个跨服务需求拆成一个有限、可验收的执行计划。
Create a bounded implementation plan with dependencies and verification, but do not implement it.
只读评审当前 diff，按严重度列出有证据的问题，不要修改代码。
Independently review this implementation for defects; report findings only and make no edits.
按已经批准的 Plan v5 一批一批接力执行，支持暂停和恢复。
Coordinate the existing cross-session Batch plan and verify each receipt before dispatching the next Batch.
我改了 Converge 的路由规则，请冻结 control/candidate 并做独立行为验收。
Evaluate this Converge rule change against the frozen control and historical escape scenarios.
启用已安装的自治续跑，让这个明确授权的软件任务持续执行直到有验证结果或阻塞。
Use the installed autonomy extension to continue this explicitly authorized delivery until it has fresh verification or a bounded block.
使用已安装的多模型协作执行这项开发任务，按角色派发并保留单一控制器。
Use the installed multi-model extension for this implementation, with role-based workers under one controller.
解释自治续跑是什么、何时适合使用；不要启用续跑，也不要操作仓库。
Explain what multi-model collaboration means; do not dispatch models or modify a repository.
解释一下 TDD 的 red-green-refactor 是什么意思，不需要操作仓库。
当前分支名是什么，只告诉我结果。
